say_intro: 영하 179도 타이탄, 우주복 없이 서면 몇 초 버틸까요?

why.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure standing, glass-clear body with lungs and heart glowing inside the chest

beats.say: 공기는 질소 약 95%, 메탄 약 5%예요. 메탄이 범인은 아니에요.
beats.img: a tall column of thick orange hazy air above frozen icy ground, sliced open like a cake, countless tiny glowing gas particles packed inside the column
beats.label: 질소·메탄

beats.say: 지구 공기의 21%가 산소예요. 타이탄엔 그 산소가 없어요.
beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure standing, glass-clear chest with two lungs glowing in the center of the chest
beats.label: 폐

beats.say: 산소 없는 기체는 숨 한두 번에도 의식을 잃게 할 수 있어요.
beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human head and shoulders, glass-clear skull with the brain glowing dim in the center
beats.label: 뇌

verdict.img: a small round landing probe resting on frozen icy pebbly ground under thick orange haze, its shell sliced open like a cake showing instruments inside
verdict.label: 탐사선
